name: Muhammad X of Granada
contribution: The nineteenth Nasrid ruler of the Emirate of Granada on the Iberian Peninsula.

checks.lead: Muhammad X of Granada (al-Saghir, “the Little One”) (c. 1427-1455) was the nineteenth Nasrid ruler of the Emirate of Granada on the Iberian Peninsula. His brief and turbulent rule was typical of the chronic instability that marked the final decades of Nasrid Granada before its fall in 1492.
